newsitem.title: UK: Reunion in Zimbabwe gold joint venturea with Rift.
newsitem.headline: Reunion in Zimbabwe gold joint venturea with Rift.

text.p: British mining and metals group Reunion Mining Plc said on Wednesday it agreed on a joint venture with Canada's Rift Resources Ltd (RRL) over the Silobela gold project in central Zimbabwe.
Reunion said its Midlands project has been divided into two parts -- Silobela and Khanye -- and it would focus its resources on the latter region.
Under the agreement, RRL will contribute all of the $1.5 million of exploration expenditure planned on the Silobela area.

Reunion said RRL has committed to an initial $250,000 programme. Once completed, RRL have the right to a 20 percent interest by providing $500,000 to be spent over a two-year period. After that period, RRL have the right to earn 30 percent by providing another $750,000, Reunion said.
